name: Silver Cross Wave / Coast Main (Upper) Car Seat Adapters
seatBrandsSupported: Clek (Liing) / Cybex (Aton, Aton Q, Cloud Q, Aton G, Cloud G) / Maxi-Cosi (Mico 30, Mico Max, Coral XP, Mico Luxe+) / Nuna (Pipa family). Retailers explicitly list the Clek Liing.

install.notes: This SX5135-EU is the MAIN (upper) adapter for a single car seat / upper position. A separate LOWER Wave/Coast car seat adapter is required to mount a seat in the lower/second position for double mode.

notes: Shared adapter for the 2019 Silver Cross Wave and the (discontinued) Coast; also works on the current Wave 3. $59.99, in stock. Clek Liing explicitly supported. For a second seat in the lower position, add the separate Wave/Coast Lower car seat adapter.
